name: Button
description: A versatile button component with multiple visual variants and sizes. Uses class-variance-authority (CVA) for variant management and supports polymorphic rendering via the asChild prop (powered by @radix-ui/react-slot). Includes focus-visible ring styles and disabled state handling.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual style variant. 'default' uses primary bg, 'destructive' uses destructive bg, 'outline' has a border with transparent bg, 'secondary' uses secondary bg, 'ghost' has no bg until hover, 'link' renders as underlined text using primary-dark color.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the button. 'default' is h-8 px-4, 'sm' is h-7 px-3 text-xs, 'lg' is h-9 px-8, 'icon' is h-7 w-7 (square).

props.name: asChild
props.description: When true, the button renders as a Radix Slot, merging its props onto the first child element. Useful for rendering as a link or other element while keeping button styles.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged via cn().

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button, reducing opacity to 50% and preventing pointer events.

accessibility.role: Renders as a native <button> element by default, providing implicit button role. When asChild is true, the rendered element determines the role.
accessibility.keyboard: Space and Enter activate the button. Tab moves focus to/from the button. Focus-visible ring appears on keyboard navigation only.
accessibility.aria: Supports all native button ARIA attributes. Use aria-label for icon-only buttons. The disabled attribute is natively handled.
accessibility.notes: SVG children are automatically sized to 16x16 (size-4) and set to pointer-events-none via the [&_svg] selector.
